title: Classify imported proof selection errors as native admission refusals
outcome: Classify imported proof selection errors as native admission refusals
acceptance: User-correctable imported proof selection errors in completion and acceptance evaluation use their native typed admission refusal rather than InvalidWorkProjection; genuine projection damage keeps its integrity classification.
Behavior tests cover wrong-run, missing-current-claim, conflicting source declaration and multiple selected acceptance-use inputs without changing stored state.
